title: Warnings and Tennis public-main integration verification

events.outcome: Verified public-main source integration for Warnings #136 and Tennis #137. Exact Warnings blobs from candidate c1408847 are present on GLP main a9d40778, and the exact 14-case deadline control passed again. Tennis main contains b17ca87, f4ee64c and c63b27ed; 14/14 focused source assertions confirm the partner record, cancellation, withdrawal and joint replacement. Both findings remain open for their recorded generated-path, policy, quota and executable-evidence work.

project_claims: Audit #5 reports that each cited Warnings and Tennis commit is an ancestor of public GLP main a9d40778.
GCE reports Warnings corrected on main with dated warnings, the seven-day safeguard, regenerated cascade artifacts and a passing Section GCE aggregate.
GM reports Tennis partner replacement corrected and certified on main, with its platform loading from the Calculus publication.
GM retains under_bound as an environment predicate pending a grammar form for counting bookings and a language decision by Udi.
source_inspection: Public GLP main is exactly a9d40778a7587dd45ea25aacb42f51146a8ab0d9; the papers branch remains 3f3d50338ec8e1d36c9122fa57fb6993c048ec45.
Comparisons show c1408847, b17ca87, f4ee64c and c63b27ed are all ancestors of a9d40778.
Warnings program, generated term, full schemas, regenerated interface, platforms and VMAT artifacts on main retain the exact c1408847 blobs.
Tennis full schemas, placeholder platform and verdict on main match c63b27ed. The readable and generated contract include Book, Cancel, Withdraw and joint Partner.
Tennis still consumes external under_bound facts for both players. Its platform.vglp states that it was not compiled because Tennis Courts has no pragmas.
